claims: The Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II is a 5th-generation single-seat all-weather stealth multirole fighter.
The Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II is designed for air superiority and strike missions.
The Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II features Mach 1.6 speed.
The Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II has three main variants: A, B, C.
The Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II variants are for conventional, STOVL, and carrier operations.
The Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II is utilized by the US and international allies.
F-35A is Conventional Takeoff and Landing (CTOL) variant for the U.S. Air Force and allies.
F-35B is Short Takeoff/Vertical Landing (STOVL) variant.
F-35B is capable of operating from smaller ships and austere bases.
F-35C is Carrier Variant (CV) with larger wing surfaces for aircraft carrier operations.
The F-35 has radar-evading design.
The F-35 radar-evading design allows it to operate in contested airspace.
The F-35 sensor fusion combines data from multiple sensors to provide pilots with high situational awareness.
The F-35 is powered by a single Pratt & Whitney F135 engine.
The Pratt & Whitney F135 engine produces 43,000 lbs of thrust.
The F-35 has top speed of Mach 1.6 (~1,200 mph).
The F-35 has a range over 1,350 miles with internal fuel.
The F-35 has internal weapons bay for stealth.
The F-35 has options for external mounts.
The F-35 is operated by the U.S. Air Force.
The F-35 is operated by the U.S. Navy.
The F-35 is operated by the U.S. Marine Corps.
The F-35 is operated by several international partners, including the UK.
Germany is increasing its F-35 order.
F-35 training is centered at Eglin Air Force Base.
The F-35 is sustained through a global network.
